name: get_email
description: Fetch the user's emails received within a date window of at most the last 7 days (by default only unread ones). Returns triage records: summaries with sender, subject and date; bodies and headers are not guaranteed complete.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601; a start more than 7 days ago is moved to 7 days ago.

inputs.name: unseen
inputs.description: true (the default) returns only unread emails; false returns every email in the window.

inputs.name: repo_update
inputs.description: Set only by the background scheduler: true stores the kept emails as email pods. Leave it unset when reading.

outputs.description: Filtered/summarized email list. Bodies/headers are not guaranteed to be complete. Use get_email_thread for full thread/body retrieval.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for get_email:
- start_date (required): start of the window, ISO 8601 (at most 7 days ago).
- end_date (required): end of the window, ISO 8601.
- unseen (optional): true (default) returns only unread emails; false returns all emails in the window.
- repo_update: leave unset; only the background scheduler sets it.

metadata.planner_description: Fetch the user's emails received in a date window of at most the last 7 days (unread only by default); returns summarized records, not full bodies.
